parameters: harness: the background glucose of the medium
harness: no lactate in the medium
harness: in-plane membrane of the 2 um cell

invariants.description: carbon balance with the membrane carriers and the matrix exported: d/dt V_c (6 C_glc + 6 C_G6P + 3 C_lac + 6 C_glyc) = 6 J_glc + 3 J_lac - 6 J_mx, integrated (relative 1e-6)
invariants.expr: abs(V_c*((6*C_glc[-1] + 6*C_G6P[-1] + 3*C_lac[-1] + 6*C_glyc[-1]) - (6*C_glc[0] + 6*C_G6P[0] + 3*C_lac[0] + 6*C_glyc[0])) - np.trapz(6*mf__J_glc + 3*mf__J_lac - 6*J_mx, t)) <= 1e-6*np.trapz(np.abs(6*mf__J_glc) + np.abs(3*mf__J_lac) + np.abs(6*J_mx), t)

invariants.description: adenine is conserved (bond-graph structure; ATP, ADP do not cross): C_ATP + C_ADP constant (relative 1e-9)
phosphoryl groups are conserved: C_ATP + C_Pi + C_G6P constant (relative 1e-9)

first law: the enthalpy brought in with glucose equals the change in stored enthalpy plus the heat, h_glc int J_glc dt = V_c (h_glc dC_glc + h_G6P dC_G6P + h_ATP dC_ATP + h_glyc dC_glyc) + int Q_met dt + (h_glc - h_mx_poly) int J_mx dt (the enthalpy the matrix carries out), relative to lactate, ADP + Pi: h_glc = 2 h_lac_gly = 126000 J/mol, h_G6P = h_glc + h_ATP - h_hk, h_glyc = h_glc - h_glyc_poly (relative 2e-4 of the heat: trapezoid integration of the output, whose G6P transients last milliseconds)
invariants.expr: abs(2*h_lac_gly*np.trapz(mf__J_glc, t) - V_c*(2*h_lac_gly*(C_glc[-1] - C_glc[0]) + (2*h_lac_gly + h_ATP - h_hk)*(C_G6P[-1] - C_G6P[0]) + h_ATP*(C_ATP[-1] - C_ATP[0]) + (2*h_lac_gly - h_glyc_poly)*(C_glyc[-1] - C_glyc[0])) - np.trapz(Q_met, t) - (2*h_lac_gly - h_mx_poly)*np.trapz(J_mx, t)) <= 2e-4*np.trapz(np.abs(Q_met), t)

invariants.description: second law: each reaction runs down its affinity, v A >= 0, so P_diss >= 0; matrix export never runs backwards (v_mx >= 0)
invariants.expr: np.all(v_gly*A_hk >= 0) and np.all(v_lg*A_lg >= 0) and np.all(v_hyd*A_hyd >= 0) and np.all(v_store*A_store >= 0) and np.all(v_mob*A_mob >= 0) and np.all(v_mx*A_mx >= 0) and np.all(v_mx >= 0) and np.all(P_diss >= 0)

invariants.description: the ATP budget by reaction follows the stoichiometry (exact): the hexokinase step spends 1, the lower glycolysis makes 3 per G6P, glycogen is credited 3 per unit mobilised and charged 2 per unit stored, the matrix n_ATP_mx + 1 per unit (its own ATP and its G6P's phosphorylation: 1 glucose + 3 ATP per unit), glycolysis has the rest; 1 per maintenance turnover; M_glyc_ATP = 3 V_c C_glyc, J_mx = V_c v_mx
invariants.expr: np.allclose(J_ATP_hk, V_c*v_gly, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(J_ATP_lg, 3*V_c*v_lg, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(J_ATP_mob, 3*V_c*v_mob, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(J_ATP_store, 2*V_c*v_store, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(J_ATP_mx, (n_ATP_mx + 1)*V_c*v_mx, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(J_ATP_gly + J_ATP_mob - J_ATP_store - J_ATP_mx, V_c*(3*v_lg - v_gly - v_store - n_ATP_mx*v_mx), rtol=1e-9, atol=1e-30) and np.allclose(J_ATP_maint, V_c*v_hyd, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(M_glyc_ATP, 3*V_c*C_glyc, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(J_mx, V_c*v_mx, rtol=1e-12, atol=0)

invariants.description: glycogen stays between 0 and its ceiling (plus 5%)

bc_sweep.rationale: temperatures from 0 to 40 C (the default factors of 0.5 and 2 would put the cell at 147 K and 586 K, where Q10 = 2 changes every rate by 2^15 to 2^29 and nothing physical remains to check); the standard Gibbs energy of glucose to lactate within about 20% of the textbook -196 kJ/mol (BioNumbers -183.6): at half of it the lower glycolysis would come near equilibrium, which no fermenter's chemistry allows; mx_alloc over its whole range (0-1)
